adjudication.rationale: In `basePath(store, type)`, the diff changes the admin-model check to `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1`. In JavaScript, `String#replace` without a regex replaces only the first underscore, so a hypothetical future admin model type with multiple underscores (e.g. `foo_bar_baz`) would become `foo-bar_baz` and fail to match an ADMIN_MODELS entry like `foo-bar-baz`, incorrectly falling back to `"/"` instead of `"/admin/"`. The diff doesn’t show any current multi-underscore admin types, so it’s not a demonstrated breakage now, but it is a specific, actionable robustness issue introduced by this change.
